title: The Advertisement
content: The Times advertisement offers four pounds a week to red-haired men for easy work at 7 Pope's Lane.

title: Wilson's Contract
content: Wilson must copy the Encyclopaedia Britannica from ten to two and never leave the office.

title: The League Ledger
content: Payments are recorded under Duncan Ross, but the money came through an unnamed backer.

title: The Tunnel
content: The basement tunnel points directly toward the bank vault.

title: The Soil Bags
content: The bags carried from the basement contain soil, not photographic chemicals.

title: The Vanished Office
content: The League office was emptied immediately after the tunnel reached the bank wall.

title: The Left-Hand Scar
content: The wanted notice for John Clay describes a scar on the left hand, matching the assistant's hidden mark.

title: The Prison Record
content: John Clay was released eight weeks ago and has a history of organized burglary.

title: The Four-Hour Alibi
content: The League's schedule kept Wilson away from the basement exactly while the tunnel was being dug.

title: The Bank Plan
content: A rough plan connects the tunnel entrance to the bank vault's blind side.

title: Ross's Ledger
content: Ross received payments from Clay and was promised a share of the robbery.

title: The Assistant's Tools
content: Dirt, a mason's chalk, and a copied key were hidden beneath the assistant's workbench.
